Violence erupts in West Bengal over alleged rape and murder of a minor

Violence has erupted in West Bengal's Baruipur area following the discovery of an 11-year-old girl's body from a pond, with allegations of rape and murder. The incident has sparked protests and political accusations. Authorities have formed an SIT to investigate, and Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari has promised swift action and assured the victim's family of justice.
